description: Passes the last message of a thread on to someone else: they receive the text quoted under its own header, with the files it carried attached again. Their answer opens a thread of its own, so forwarding to the account support address is how a message reaches the support queue, in that direction only.

bcc.description: Who else receives it without the others being told. A blind copy is kept on the sending alone: the thread records the visible recipients only.

cc.description: Who else receives it, in copy. Everyone on the mail sees these.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it.

note.description: What to say above the quoted message, in your own words. Left out, only the quotation goes.

name: forward_conversation
title: Forward a message
